Appendix A

Appendix — Commands, demo accounts & permission catalogue

A.1 Command cheat-sheet

Table A.1 — Commands
KaamCommandKahan se
MySQL data folder banana (aik dafa).\database\local\init.ps1Project root
MySQL start (background).\database\local\start.ps1 -BackgroundProject root
MySQL stop.\database\local\stop.ps1Project root
App database + user banana.\database\local\create-app-db.ps1Project root
Sab kuch start (DB + API + frontend).\start-dev.ps1Project root
PHP packagescomposer installbackend
App keyphp artisan key:generatebackend
DB connection checkphp artisan db:checkbackend
DB self-testphp artisan db:selftestbackend
Schema + permissionsphp artisan migrate --seedbackend
Production migrationphp artisan migrate --forcebackend
Permission catalogue (prod)php artisan db:seed --forcebackend
Demo data (sirf dev)php artisan db:seed --class=DemoSeederbackend
Pehla platform ownerphp artisan erp:create-adminbackend
Pehla owner (production)ERP_ALLOW_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP=true php artisan erp:create-admin --forcebackend
API server (dev)php artisan servebackend
Queue workerphp artisan queue:work --tries=3backend
Scheduler (dev)php artisan schedule:workbackend
Failed jobsphp artisan queue:failedbackend
Retention cleanup previewphp artisan erp:prune --dry-runbackend
Low-stock check (manual)php artisan inventory:check-reorderbackend
Config cache (prod)php artisan config:cache route:cache event:cachebackend
Cache saaf karnaphp artisan optimize:clearbackend
Backend testsphp artisan testbackend
Frontend packagesnpm installfrontend
Frontend dev servernpm run devfrontend
Frontend production buildnpm run buildfrontend
Is guide ke screenshotsnpm run screenshotsdocs\build
Is guide ka PDFnpm run guidedocs\build
Dhyan dein
Production par kabhi nahi: migrate:fresh, migrate:reset, migrate:rollback, db:wipe, DemoSeeder.

A.2 Demo accounts

DEVELOPMENT ONLY
